summary: The implementation satisfies the planned architecture and functional acceptance criteria: separated simulation and Canvas rendering, pointer and keyboard controls, automatic firing, responsive layout, resource limits, lifecycle cleanup, visibility handling, reduced-motion initialization, and Canvas fallback. All 40 automated tests passed and the production build exited successfully. The final mobile CSS addresses the previously reported control overflow. Missing manual visual testing is not a conformance blocker under the supplied rules.
deviations: Added optional muted-by-default audio, statistics, and a clear button.
Added a custom loopback static server and automated browser verification script alongside Vite preview.
remaining_risks: The supplied results do not establish that the browser verification script completed or that a localhost server remains running for handoff; the verifier closes its server on completion.
